description: Perform a thin content audit on https://books.toscrape.com/. STEPS: 1) Crawl the website using Screaming Frog. 2) After the crawl completes, go to the 'Internal' tab and filter by 'HTML'. 3) Export this data (which includes the 'Word Count' column) to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/. 4) Analyze the word count data and write a report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/thin_content_report.txt. The report must include: counts of pages with <100 words, 100-300 words, and >300 words; a list of the 5 thinnest page URLs; and remediation recommendations.
